source_builder: host_wild_defeat_event uses actual existing record kind=wild, opponent HP=0/owner_npc empty, actual saved enemy UID/species/level/maxHP matched to host opponent capture card, positive actual body generation, host admitted participant character/joined sequence, and CURRENT owned deployment UID. event_identity: wild_defeat:<SHA256([world_namespace,session_epoch,realm,encounter_id,body_generation,actual_enemy_uid])>. Freeze once at accepted killing-hit hook; independent of later presentation seq/wind/terminal broadcast. Reconnect/reload recovers ORIGINAL event from existing durable carrier, never rebuilds with a new epoch. Different respawn body/session IDs can earn again, same action per character cannot.
recipient_policy: Each actual admitted fight participant receives its own transaction; no nonparticipant. Eligible creatures are all actual living owned members (max five). Fainted active member receives nothing while living bench still gets its existing reduced share; never choose an invented new active UID to give the full award. All-fainted has no eligible XP recipient and explicitly refuses. Current deployment, not opening participant UID, decides full versus bench after tag switch.

No preexisting max/boost/IV/known/mastery history reset, no healing, no default/missing cap invention, no future tier lift.

Actual main xp_award_for, party_share, rest bonuses and every old function byte-preserved.
